lines.en: label rinspring8:
scene rinmaidtime1
: Two, please.
lines.zh: : 两位，谢谢。

lines.en: : But I also didn’t mean {i}today...{/i}
lines.zh: : 不过我也没说是{i}今天……{/i}

lines.en: : M-Master! And...Lady Master! Hi! Uhh...you two have never come here together before! How...curious!
lines.zh: : M-Master！还有……Lady Master！你们好！呃……你们两位以前从没一起来过！真……稀奇！

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime2
: How many girls {i}have{/i} you come here with?
lines.zh: : 你带多少个女孩子{i}来过{/i}这儿？

lines.en: : I’ve lost count, to be honest. I enter a trance-like state when I’m in here because Uta is too good at her job.
lines.zh: : 说实话我已经数不清了。我一进这儿就会进入恍惚状态，因为 Uta 太擅长她的工作了。

lines.en: : Anything for my precious princes and princesses! And what joy it brings me to be able to serve {i}both{/i} of you at once today!
lines.zh: : 为了我珍贵的王子殿下和公主殿下，什么都愿意做！今天能同时为{i}两位{/i}服务，我有多开心你们知道吗！

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime3
: Oh, sorry. We’re actually here for Chika. I want {i}her{/i} to serve us.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。我们其实是冲 Chika 来的。我想让{i}她{/i}来招待我们。

lines.en: : How about both of you serve us? Without clothes on.
lines.zh: : 不如你们两个一起招待我们？不穿衣服的那种。

lines.en: : I think that’s illegal.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那是违法的。

lines.en: : When has that ever stopped me?
lines.zh: : 那什么时候拦住过我？

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime4
: Hey — we have a mission, remember? This is no time to be instilling new fantasies in me. The last thing we want is me falling for Uta next when we’re so close to the finish line.
lines.zh: : 嘿——我们有任务在身，记得吗？现在可不是往我脑子里塞新幻想的时候。我们都快到终点线了，最不希望的就是我接着又迷上 Uta。

lines.en: : H...How close exactly? If I’m...allowed to ask. Out of character.
lines.zh: : 到、到底有多近？如果……允许我问的话。出戏了。

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime5
: Not {i}that{/i} close, I guess. All we’ve really done is kiss so far.
lines.zh: : 大概也没{i}那么{/i}近。我们目前为止其实只接过吻。

lines.en: : Oh, same.
lines.zh: : 哦，一样。

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime6
: Hey, cool! Mouth-twins!
lines.zh: : 嘿，真巧！嘴上双胞胎！

lines.en: : I don’t like how casual this is becoming for everyone. It sometimes feels like I’m the one being strung along at this point.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢大家都变得这么无所谓。有时候我都觉得自己才是那个被吊着的人了。

lines.en: : Soooo...table for two? Are you sure? Or do you maybe want to separate and I can serve the handsome Master while Chika-chan takes care of you?
lines.zh: : 那——么……两位一桌？确定吗？还是说你们想分开坐，我来招待帅气的 Master，让 Chika-chan 去照顾你？

lines.en: : We need to sit together, unfortunately. I want to ruin Chika’s day.
lines.zh: : 可惜我们得坐一起。我想毁掉 Chika 的一天。

lines.en: : I feel as if I’ve somehow become a third wheel on my own date.
lines.zh: : 我感觉自己莫名其妙地成了自己约会上的电灯泡。

lines.en: : Cars need four wheels to drive! Double date! I get him!
lines.zh: : 车子要四个轮子才开得动！双人约会！他归我！

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime7
: When did you get this openly thirsty?
lines.zh: : 你什么时候变得这么明目张胆地饥渴了？

lines.en: : Like 2015 something. I just hide it well. Chika-chan! You have customers!
lines.zh: : 大概 2015 年那会儿吧。我只是藏得好。Chika-chan！有客人！

lines.en: : Haaaaai!
scene rinmaidtime8
: Boy, I sure can’t wait to sit down and chat with our maid! I bet she’s really-
lines.zh: : 哇，我真是等不及坐下来跟我们的女仆聊聊天了！我敢打赌她一定很——

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime9
: AAAAAAHHHH!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime10
: Hm? What was-
lines.zh: : 嗯？刚才那是——

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime11
: AAAAAAAAHHHH!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: : YOU CHANGED YOUR HAIR BACK!
lines.zh: : 你把头发换回来了！

lines.en: : W-W-W-W-WHAT ARE YOU DOING HERE? LEAVE! GO!
lines.zh: : 你、你、你、你们在这儿干什么？走开！出去！

lines.en: : NO! My {i}BOYFRIEND{/i} and I would like an omelet! {i}One{/i} omelet! Served to us by a hot Filipina maid that we can share!
lines.zh: : 不！我和我的{i}男朋友{/i}想要一份欧姆蛋！{i}一份{/i}欧姆蛋！由一位辣辣的菲律宾女仆端上来，我们可以一起分享！

lines.en: : The maid or the omelet?
lines.zh: : 是女仆还是欧姆蛋？

lines.en: : WHO KNOWS?!
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢？！

lines.en: : Chika-chan? Who are they?
lines.zh: : Chika-chan？他们是谁啊？

lines.en: : Yeah, you’re not ignoring us in favor of other customers, are you?
lines.zh: : 是啊，你该不会为了别的客人就无视我们吧？

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime12

: {size=-2}What did I tell you about speaking before you’re spoken to, you trashy, donkey-fucking whore? I will never love you and I will cut your fucking tongue off if you refuse to learn the rules. Do you understand?{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}我跟你说的规矩是什么来着？没跟你说话就不许开口，你这个垃圾、和驴交配的婊子？我永远都不会爱你，你要是死活学不会规矩，我就把你他妈的舌头割下来。明白了吗？{/size}

lines.en: : Is this really the maid you guys wanted when there’s that cute redhead working here? Why?
lines.zh: : 这儿明明还有那么可爱的红头发在，你们真要选这位女仆？为什么啊？

lines.en: : You just don’t get it, Tiffany.
lines.zh: : 你就是不懂，Tiffany。

lines.en: : So do we just seat ourselves or what?
lines.zh: : 那我们就自己找位子坐了？

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime13
: Yes! Somewhere else! Because I suddenly have to go on break for the exact amount of time that you’re going to be here!
lines.zh: : 对！坐别处去！因为我突然得去休息了，休息时长正好等于你们要待的时长！

lines.en: : Oh, great. We’ll go with you then. I’ve always wondered what the locker room looks like. Specifically while there are girls in it getting dressed and/or undressed.
lines.zh: : 哦，太好了。那我们跟你一起去。我一直很好奇更衣室长什么样。特别是里面有女孩正在穿衣服、以及/或者脱衣服的时候。

lines.en: : Uta! Some help, please! We’re allowed to refuse customers, right?!
lines.zh: : Uta！帮帮忙吧！我们是可以拒绝客人的吧？！

lines.en: : Not unless they’re foreigners. Upper management cares way more about our Tabelog score than our Google Reviews one.
lines.zh: : 除非他们是外国人。上层管理层在乎我们 Tabelog 的评分，可比在乎 Google 评论多多了。

lines.en: : I think you’re just going to have to do it, Chika. I’ve already tried to-
lines.zh: : 我觉得你只能硬着头皮上了，Chika。我已经试过——

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime14
: {i}No! You can’t make me!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不！你不能逼我！{/i}

lines.en: : Ch-Chika, wait! You can’t just run away in the middle of a shift!
lines.zh: : Ch-Chika，等等！你不能上班上到一半就这么跑掉啊！

lines.en: : {i}Then I quit!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那我辞职！{/i}

lines.en: : Just what the fuck happened between you guys? My existence has barely been acknowledged.
lines.zh: : 你们两个之间到底他妈发生了什么？我的存在几乎都没被理过。

lines.en: : All going according to plan, I’d say. Thanks for the idea, Sensei. You can leave the rest to me now.
lines.zh: : 我说，一切都在按计划进行。点子谢啦，Sensei。剩下的就交给我吧。

lines.en: : Uhh...you guys can just take a seat at that empty table over there. I need to go...repair the number two maid before the rankings change.
lines.zh: : 呃……你们两位就去那边那张空桌子坐吧。我得去……在排名变动之前修好二号女仆。

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime15
: So, are you going to tell me what’s really going on now that I have been sucked into some sort of teenage drama?
lines.zh: : 那么，既然我已经被卷进了某种青少年闹剧，你能告诉我到底怎么回事了吗？

lines.en: : Chika doesn’t want to be friends with me anymore because of reasons. Mostly she just thinks she’s crazy now. Which she is.
lines.zh: : Chika 因为某些原因不想再跟我做朋友了。主要就是她现在觉得自己疯了。而她确实是。

lines.en: : But why will cutting {i}you{/i} out fix that? You’re not what’s making her crazy, I am.
lines.zh: : 可为什么把{i}你{/i}踢开就能解决那个问题？让她发疯的人又不是你，是我。

lines.en: : I think we both are in different ways. And that you’re not far from being cut out too, so we should band together right now and force her to keep spending time with us.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们两个都以不同的方式有份。而且你也快被踢掉了，所以我们现在就该联手，逼她继续跟我们待在一起。

lines.en: : Even at the expense of her happiness and who she hopes to be as a person?
lines.zh: : 哪怕以她的幸福、和她想成为的那个人为代价？

lines.en: : Yes. Even at the expense of those things.
lines.zh: : 对。哪怕以那些东西为代价。

lines.en: : Rin, are you actually evil?
lines.zh: : Rin，你其实是反派吧？

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime16
: No! What’s {i}evil{/i} is that someone could do something so self-motivated without any regard for how the person they’re doing it {i}to{/i} feels! Especially when that person loves her a lot!
lines.zh: : 才不是！真正的{i}恶{/i}是：有人能做出那么自私的事，却完全不在乎被他这么{i}对待{/i}的人是什么感受！尤其是那个人还很爱她的时候！

lines.en: : So...exactly what you’re doing right now?
lines.zh: : 所以……就是你现在正在做的事？

lines.en: : Yes, but you don’t have to point it out!
lines.zh: : 是，但你用不着指出来！

lines.en: : I get it. I mean, you’re here with {i}me.{/i} A man who constantly does self-motivated things at the cost of others.
lines.zh: : 我懂。毕竟你现在是跟{i}我{/i}在一起。一个常年以牺牲他人为代价做着自私之事的男人。

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime17
: Sure. But it’s {i}normal{/i} when you do that because that’s how you’ve always been. So of course I’m going to think sudden changes in Chika are a lot more...malleable. I can fix her.
lines.zh: : 没错。可你做这种事很{i}正常{/i}，因为你一直都是这样。所以我当然会觉得，Chika 身上的突然变化要……好捏得多。我能修好她。

lines.en: : Well, I sincerely apologize that you feel inclined to fix the things that I have broken. And I hope forcing her into an uncomfortable situation accomplishes that for you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我很抱歉，让你忍不住想去修补那些被我弄坏的东西。也希望把她逼进难堪的境地能让你如愿。

lines.en: : Anyway, when can we make out?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，我们什么时候能接吻？

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime18
: I’ll jump across the table once she comes back out and start kissing you. Then you can count until five and start taking my clothes off.
lines.zh: : 等她一出来，我就扑过桌子开始吻你。然后你数到五，就开始脱我的衣服。

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime19
: Well, {i}you{/i} guys are certainly a lot closer all of a sudden. I’m afraid I can’t let you do that, though. Even if it is, like, {i}years{/i} overdue at this point.
lines.zh: : 哇，{i}你们{/i}两个突然亲近了好多啊。不过我恐怕不能让你们那么做。哪怕这事儿说起来已经迟了{i}好几年{/i}。

lines.en: : Hi, Ami. Rest assured, I am only here to make Chika’s life harder today. And if it helps preserve our friendship, I will wait until I am alone with your dad to let him take my clothes off.
lines.zh: : 你好，Ami。放心，我今天来纯粹是为了让 Chika 的日子更难过。而且如果这能保住我们的友情，我会等到跟你爸独处的时候再让他脱我的衣服。

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime20
: That’s really all I ask at this point. Thank you, Rin.
lines.zh: : 我现在要的也就是这个了。谢谢你，Rin。

lines.en: : Hi, Ami. Still last place in the popularity rankings?
lines.zh: : 你好，Ami。人气排名还是垫底吗？

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime21
: Unfortunately, yeah. But I’ve been thinking about pivoting to a more incest-focused character in the future so I can play better to my strengths.
lines.zh: : 很遗憾，是的。不过我在考虑以后转型成一个更偏禁忌恋路线的角色，好发挥我的长处。

lines.en: : It’s just all girls, though. And I’ve found that most girls don’t really like it when you call them “Daddy.”
lines.zh: : 可这儿全是女孩子啊。而且我发现大多数女生都不太喜欢你叫她们「爸爸」。

lines.en: : I’ll let you call {i}me{/i} “Daddy” if you want to.
lines.zh: : 你要是想，我可以让你叫{i}我{/i}「爸爸」。

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime22
: No thanks. That’ll just make things confusing when you inevitably start having sex with mine.
lines.zh: : 谢了不用。等你迟早跟我爸上床的时候，那只会让事情变复杂。

lines.en: : What’s wrong with two dads having sex together?
lines.zh: : 两个当爸的在一起上床有什么问题？

lines.en: : Nothing so long as I’m in the room. Keep that in mind when the time comes.
lines.zh: : 只要我在场就没问题。到时候记住这一点。

lines.en: : Uhh...okay.
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧。

lines.en: : {i}Ahem.{/i}
scene rinmaidtime23
: Hi.
: Ami, could you go check if Chika’s ready to come out yet?
lines.zh: : Ami，你能去看看 Chika 准备好出来了吗？

lines.en: : Can you promise to select me the next time you come here so I can stop feeling bad about you choosing Uta instead?
lines.zh: : 你能不能答应下次来的时候选我，好让我别再因为你选了 Uta 而难受？

lines.en: : How about you just wear the outfit while making dinner for me tonight? Does that work?
lines.zh: : 不如你今晚穿着那套衣服给我做晚饭？这样行吗？

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime24
: {i}Chika! Can you get out here and do your frickin’ job already before we wind up having to stop those two from having sex on the table?!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Chika！你能不能滚出来干你那份该死的工作，免得我们最后还得拦着那两个在桌子上做爱？！{/i}

lines.en: : You two have a weird relationship, Sensei. I can’t help but get grossed out whenever my mom talks about stuff like that and here {i}you{/i} are letting her wear a maid costume around the house.
lines.zh: : 你们两个的关系真奇怪，Sensei。我妈一聊到那种事我就忍不住犯恶心，而{i}你{/i}倒好，还让她穿着女仆装在屋里晃。

lines.en: : She can wear the costume and have it still be wholesome.
lines.zh: : 她可以穿着那套衣服，同时依然很纯情。

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime25
: Then you’re stronger than me because I can not see that dress as anything other than an article of clothing specifically designed to tear off in the heat of a horny rampage.
lines.zh: : 那你比我强，因为我没法把那条裙子看成别的东西——它分明就是一件专为在饥渴暴走的热头上一把扯掉而设计的衣服。

lines.en: : So if your mom were to wear the dress-
lines.zh: : 那要是你妈也穿那条裙子——

lines.en: : Sensei, please. We are in a {i}restaurant.{/i}
lines.zh: : Sensei，拜托。我们可是在{i}餐厅{/i}里。

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime26
: Hi. Me again. So, cuttin’ right to the chase, we’ve got a bit of an issue.
lines.zh: : 嗨。又是我。那我就直说了，我们遇到点小状况。

lines.en: : What kind of issue, Uta? Because I’ll have you know that I {i}do{/i} have a Tabelog account and I am not afraid to use it.
lines.zh: : 什么状况，Uta？我先说清楚，我{i}可是{/i}有 Tabelog 账号的，而且我不怕用。

lines.en: : Right, yeah. So, {i}that’s{/i} fine. And if you {i}really{/i} want Chika to be the one to take care of you guys, I’ll make it happen. But, like...is that {i}really{/i} what you want?
lines.zh: : 对，是是是。{i}那就{/i}好。如果你们{i}真{/i}想让 Chika 来招待，我可以办到。不过……你们{i}真{/i}想要这个吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
scene rinmaidtime27
: Over me?
lines.zh: : 选她不选我？

lines.en: : Yes.
: Uta-chan.
lines.zh: : Uta-chan。

lines.en: : Yes.
: The girl who is specifically designed to appeal to everyone, boys and girls alike, who has an almost perfect track record when it comes to customer care and satisfaction?
lines.zh: : 那个天生就能讨好所有人、男女通吃的女孩，在顾客关怀和满意度上几乎有着满分记录的女孩？

lines.en: : Yes.
: What if I offer to comp your meals?
lines.zh: : 要是我给你们免单呢？

lines.en: : I still want Chika.
lines.zh: : 我还是要 Chika。

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime28
: What if I take my top off?!
lines.zh: : 那要是我把上衣脱了呢？！

lines.en: : Uhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh.............
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃……

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: : 真的假的？

lines.en: : Uta, I can’t believe I’m saying this, but don’t take your top off.
lines.zh: : Uta，我真不敢相信自己会说出这种话，但你别脱上衣。

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime29
: I can’t believe you’re saying this either! You’ve been tryin’ to see Uta-chan’s mini-Utas for as long as you’ve been coming here! Why’s this not working?! Am I not cute anymore?!
lines.zh: : 我也真不敢相信你会说这话！你从打来这儿的第一天起就一直想看 Uta-chan 的迷你 Uta！怎么就不灵了？！我不可爱了吗？！

lines.en: : You’re adorable, Uta. I just kind of {i}need{/i} it to be Chika because I can’t get her to talk to me under any other circumstance and must now use force.
lines.zh: : 你可爱极了，Uta。我只是{i}需要{/i}那个人是 Chika，因为在任何其他情况下我都没法让她跟我说话，所以现在只能来硬的。

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime30
: Which {i}would{/i} be fine...if she was not having a total episode right now.
lines.zh: : 那{i}倒还{/i}好……如果她现在没有正在全面发作的话。

lines.en: : Well, how much longer until her episode ends? We don’t mind waiting.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那她还要发作多久？我们不着急。

lines.en: : Uhhh...
: Let me go check.
lines.zh: : 我去看看。

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime31
: FUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUCK!!!!!!!!!!!!!! WHY?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!!
: J-J-J-Just treat them like any other customers, Chika! Put your game face on and get back in character! It should be {i}easy{/i} with all the crazy-person practice you’ve gotten lately!
lines.zh: : 就、就、就把他们当普通客人对待，Chika！摆出你的战斗脸，回到角色里！凭你最近练出来的那一身疯子本事，这应该{i}不难{/i}吧！

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime32
: What’s {i}easy{/i} about being confronted at {i}work{/i} when I told her to stay away from me?! Isn’t this crossing a line?!
lines.zh: : 我都叫她离我远点了，她还在{i}上班的地方{/i}堵我，这有什么{i}容易{/i}的？！这难道不过分吗？！

lines.en: : A bunch of them! But if Rin was the one who cut {i}you{/i} off, I bet {i}you’d{/i} suddenly feel a lot more inclined to go buy overpriced coffee, right?
lines.zh: : 过分的地方一大堆！可如果是 Rin 先甩了{i}你{/i}，我打赌{i}你{/i}立刻就会更有兴致跑去买贵得要死的咖啡，对吧？

lines.en: : It’s not {i}my{/i} fault Koi Cafe is the only place in town where I can get a pumpkin spice latte year round! Sue me, Uta! Fucking sue me!
lines.zh: : Koi Cafe 是镇上唯一一家一年四季都能喝到南瓜香料拿铁的地方，这又不是{i}我的{/i}错！告我啊，Uta！他妈的告我啊！

lines.en: : Just go out there and treat her like any other guest. And {i}Sensei’s{/i} there too! You love him, right? Just lean on {i}him{/i} for support.
lines.zh: : 就出去，把她当普通客人对待。而且 {i}Sensei{/i} 也在啊！你爱他，不是吗？靠着{i}他{/i}就好了。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m sure he’ll {i}love{/i} hearing about the time I ate out his date! Or how pissed off I get at the thought of him touching her because I want her to belong to {b}ME{/b} and me only!
lines.zh: : 是啊，他肯定{i}爱听{/i}我讲我怎么舔他约会对象的！或者一听他碰她我就气成什么样——因为我要她属于{b}我{/b}，只属于我一个人！

lines.zh: : 哦滚蛋，ampota！我跟你爸做过的事能让你他妈做噩梦！Huwag ka nang magsalita！

lines.en: : It’ll be hard, sure. But you’re going to {i}have{/i} to deal with things like this for a little while, Chika. It’s totally fair that Rin wouldn’t just roll over and let you go without a fight.
lines.zh: : 当然会很难。但这种事你{i}总得{/i}应付一阵子，Chika。Rin 不肯就这么乖乖认输、放你走，那完全合情合理。

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime34
: So?! That doesn’t make it any less hard!

lines.en: : She’s doing this on purpose just to piss me off! I hate it! And in this fucking costume, it feels so fucking demeaning! Like I’m a fucking toy for her to use and-
lines.zh: : 她是故意这么干来气我的！我恨死了！而且穿着这身该死的制服，感觉简直他妈的屈辱！就好像我是她的一个该死玩具，用来——

: Great! Now I’m horny too! Could today get any fucking worse?!
lines.zh: : 好极了！连我都湿了！今天还能再他妈糟一点吗？！

lines.en: : Just go take their order at least. You can skip the small talk and blah, blah, blah. But you can’t let her get to you like this or it’ll happen {i}everywhere.{/i}
lines.zh: : 至少过去把他们的单点了。寒暄和废话什么的你可以省了。但你不能让她这么影响到你，不然{i}到哪儿{/i}都会这样。

lines.en: : I can’t!

lines.en: : Chika, look at me.
lines.zh: : Chika，看着我。

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime36
: You are a strong, independent maid who don’t need no man {i}or{/i} woman! Say it with me!
lines.zh: : 你是一个强大独立的女仆，不需要任何男人{i}或{/i}女人！跟我一起说！

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不要。

lines.en: : Fair enough! But the fact remains that you are way more mature than you give yourself credit for! You’ve done a million bigger things than this! You can overcome anything if you try!
lines.zh: : 行吧！可事实仍然是，你远比你自己以为的要成熟！比这大得多的事你都做成过一百万件了！只要肯试，你什么都能克服！

lines.en: : {i}That’s{/i} the Chika-chan I know! Not {i}this{/i} one who folds just because there’s a cute girl she can’t currently handle! You got that?!
lines.zh: : {i}这才是{/i}我认识的 Chika-chan！而不是{i}这个{/i}只是因为有个她暂时对付不了的可爱女孩就退缩的家伙！听到了吗？！

lines.en: : {i}Sniff...{/i}Thank you, Uta. But if I ever take sexual advantage of you and then tell you to go away, please just listen. This is hard.
lines.zh: :  {i}sniff……{/i}谢谢你，Uta。不过要是哪天我占了你性方面的便宜、然后又叫你走开，请你直接听话。这很难。

lines.en: : Great! Now {i}I’m{/i} horny too! You are tearing this cafe apart!
lines.zh: : 好极了！连{i}我都{/i}湿了！你快把这家咖啡厅拆了！

lines.en: : Alis! Huwag kang humarang diyan!
lines.zh: : Alis! Huwag kang humarang diyan!

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime37
: Why, if it isn’t our very own Chika-chan, finally here to take our order. Why did you change your hair?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，这不正是我们的 Chika-chan 吗，终于来点单了。你为什么把头发换回来了？

lines.en: : The same reason you changed yours...Now, what can I get for you?
lines.zh: : 跟你换发型的理由一样……那么，两位要点什么？

lines.en: : I’m not sure. I haven’t really thought about it yet. In fact, it might take me a really long time to do that. So why don’t you take my {i}boyfriend’s{i} order first?
lines.zh: : 我不确定。我还没怎么想好。事实上，我大概得想很久。所以不如你先点我{i}男朋友{/i}那份？

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime38
: So, did she come to you specifically to try and get back at me or what?
lines.zh: : 那么，她是专门来找你想报复我的，还是怎么的？

lines.en: : I think this might actually be my fault on a technical level. I’m pretty sure she just wanted to hang out. I had no idea it would snowball into whatever is happening right now.
lines.zh: : 从技术层面说，这事可能其实是我的错。我敢肯定她本来只是想出来玩玩。我完全没料到会滚成现在这副样子。

lines.en: : So you just don’t even know?
lines.zh: : 所以你连这都不知道？

lines.en: : I know there is something I {i}don’t{/i} know. And that I’ll find out eventually. But yeah, right now I’m kind of just confused and hungry and mildly aroused.
lines.zh: : 我知道有某件我{i}不{/i}知道的事。而且我迟早会查明白。不过没错，我现在就是又困惑、又饿、还有点性奋。

lines.en: : That’s pretty much my baseline, so I can relate.
lines.zh: : 那基本就是我的常态，所以我能理解。

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime39
: Are you proud of yourself for this? Do you really have no idea how much it hurts?
lines.zh: : 你这么做很得意吗？你真的一点都不知道这有多伤人吗？

lines.en: : Oh, no. I {i}want{/i} it to hurt. I want you to spend every waking moment agonizing over it since that’s what {i}I’ve{/i} had to do since Christmalloween. Seems only fair to me.
lines.zh: : 哦，不。我{i}就是要{/i}它伤人。我要你醒着的每一刻都为它备受煎熬，因为从 Christmalloween 起，{i}我{/i}一直都在受这种煎熬。我觉得这才公平。

lines.en: : You could have saved yourself a trip {i}and{/i} some money by knowing that I already {i}have{/i} been agonizing, Rin. All this is doing is wasting your time.
lines.zh: : Rin，你要是知道我{i}早就{/i}在备受煎熬了，本来可以省下这趟路{i}和{/i}这笔钱的。你现在做的只是浪费时间。

lines.en: : Oh, silly me. It’s just hard for me to know {i}anything{/i} when {i}you{/i} won’t even make eye contact with me at school, coward.
lines.zh: : 哦，是我傻。可{i}你{/i}在学校连正眼都不看我一眼，我又能知道{i}什么{/i}呢，胆小鬼。

lines.en: : I’m making it now, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 我现在不正在看吗？

lines.en: : You sure are. And how does that feel, Chika?
lines.zh: : 你确实在看。那感觉如何，Chika？

lines.en: : Like a million icepicks being forced beneath my nails while someone drills holes into my heart.
lines.zh: : 就像一百万把冰锥被扎进我的指甲缝里，同时还有人在我心脏上钻孔。

lines.en: : If I didn’t know any better, I’d assume the two of you have been secretly dating or something.
lines.zh: : 要不是我心里有数，我都要以为你们两个在偷偷交往什么的了。

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime40
: Or something, for sure.
lines.zh: : 什么的，确实是。

lines.en: : Listen, if you two aren’t ready to order yet, I’ll give you another few minutes and come back. Okay? Okay. Bye.
lines.zh: : 那个，要是你们还没想好点什么，我再给你们几分钟，待会儿再来。好吗？好。拜。

lines.en: : One omelet, Chika. And whatever today’s special parfait is.
lines.zh: : 一份欧姆蛋，Chika。再加今天的特色芭菲。

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime41
: Could you tell us what that is, by the way? I’ve been so focused on my {i}boyfriend{/i} that I haven’t even looked at the menu yet.
lines.zh: : 顺便能告诉我们那是什么吗？我光顾着看我{i}男朋友{/i}了，连菜单都还没看。

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}really?
: Really.
lines.zh: : 真的。

lines.en: : It’s the very merry cherry berry prince and princess parfait, made with five different types of berries, a splash of love, and a kiss mixed in.
lines.zh: : 是超级欢乐的樱桃浆果王子公主芭菲，用了五种不同的浆果，加了一抹爱意，还拌进了一个吻。

lines.en: : Sounds {i}delightful.{/i} Could I get an extra kiss with mine?
lines.zh: : 听起来{i}很棒{/i}。我那份能多加一个吻吗？

lines.en: : No modifications. Everything is sold as-is.
lines.zh: : 不接受改动。所有商品均为原样出售。

lines.en: : Not even for me? Then how will I know you love me?
lines.zh: : 连我都不行？那我怎么知道你爱我？

lines.en: : I’ll be back soon with your order.
lines.zh: : 我很快就回来上菜。

lines.en: scene rinmaidtime42
: Wow, Rin. You’re, uhh...really giving her a tough time today.
lines.zh: : 哇，Rin。你……呃……今天可真是把她往死里为难啊。

lines.en: : Only because I {i}have{/i} to. I’ve been avoided for so long that I’m kind of furious, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 只是因为我{i}不得不{/i}这样。我被躲了那么久，说实话都有点恼火了。

lines.en: : Sorry if it’s killing the vibe. I’ll go back to normal after this. Just felt like I needed to jump on the opportunity since we don’t exactly get to chill as much as we used to.
lines.zh: : 抱歉把气氛搞成这样。这事之后我就恢复正常了。只是觉得得抓住这个机会，毕竟我们也不像从前那样能经常见面了。

lines.en: : Which you {i}do{/i} want to...right?
lines.zh: : 而你{i}确实{/i}想……对吧？

lines.en: : Of course. Why wouldn’t I?
lines.zh: : 当然。我为什么不想？

lines.en: : You just seem a little more focused on Chika right now. Which is fine if that’s where your heart is again. I mean, I get it. You’ve always kind of-
lines.zh: : 你只是现在看起来更把心思放在 Chika 身上。如果你的心又回到她那儿了，那也没关系。我的意思是，我懂。你一直都有点——

lines.en: : Just for now. But, like I said, after this, we’re-
